text:
Estimated portions before eating:
- Lasagna slice, about 250 g at roughly 150 kcal/100 g, so about 375 kcal.
- Potatoes, 4 small, about 200 g at 77 kcal/100 g, so about 150 kcal. Two are left, so about half was eaten: roughly 100 g and 75 kcal.
- Vegetables (broccoli, carrot, corn), about 100 g at 50 kcal/100 g, so about 50 kcal. Almost all was eaten: about 90 g and 45 kcal.
- Fruit bowl, about 150 g at 45 kcal/100 g, so about 70 kcal. The second photo shows fruit left over, and it looks like strawberries were added, so the bowl may have been swapped. About 60% of the original was eaten: roughly 90 g and 40 kcal.
- Cola, about 200 ml at 42 kcal/100 ml, so about 85 kcal. The glass is nearly empty, so about 80 kcal. A liquid is not food mass, so I left it out of the grams.
- Water adds no energy.

Lasagna: nearly all eaten, with only a thin crust left on the plate. About 230 g eaten, which is about 345 kcal.

Totals:
- Energy: 345 + 75 + 45 + 40 + 80 = 585 kcal
- Mass of food (excluding drinks): 230 + 100 + 90 + 90 = 510 g
